data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to generate returns that corresponds to the total returns of the securities asrepresented by the CRISIL-IBX Gilt Index-April 2028 (before fees and expenses), subject to tracking errors. However, there canbe no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved. The Scheme does not guarantee/ indicate anyreturns.
